n.components.practice-day-card.before-li.en: Everyone runs the mock election on the same day, and the combined count is shared.
n.components.practice-day-card.before-li.ha: Kowa zai yi zaɓen gwaji a rana ɗaya, kuma za a raba jimillar ƙidayar.
n.components.practice-day-card.before-li.ig: Onye ọ bụla na-eme ntuli aka omume n’otu ụbọchị ahụ, a na-ekerịta ngụkọta ya.
n.components.practice-day-card.before-li.yo: Gbogbo ènìyàn ló máa ṣe ìdìbò àdánwò ní ọjọ́ kan náà, a ó sì pín àpapọ̀ ìkàyè.

n.components.practice-day-card.live-none.en: No one has practised yet today. Be the first.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-none.ha: Babu wanda ya yi atisaye tukuna a yau. Ka zama na farko.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-none.ig: Ọ dịbeghị onye mere omume taa. Bụrụ onye mbụ.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-none.yo: Kò sí ẹni tó tíì ṣe àdánwò lónìí. Jẹ́ ẹni àkọ́kọ́.

n.components.practice-day-card.live-coun.ha: Mai lura 1 ya yi atisaye a yau.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-coun.ig: Onye na-ekiri ihe 1 emeela omume taa.

n.components.practice-day-card.live-coun.ha: Masu lura {v0} sun yi atisaye a yau.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-coun.ig: Ndị na-ekiri ihe {v0} emeela omume taa.
n.components.practice-day-card.live-coun.yo: Àwọn olùwòran {v0} ti ṣe àdánwò lónìí.

n.components.practice-day-card.after-non.ha: Babu mai lura da ya yi atisaye a {v0}.
n.components.practice-day-card.after-non.ig: Ọ dịghị onye na-ekiri ihe mere omume na {v0}.
n.components.practice-day-card.after-non.yo: Kò sí olùwòran tó ṣe àdánwò ní {v0}.

n.components.practice-day-card.after-cou.ha: Mai lura 1 ya yi atisaye a {v0}.
n.components.practice-day-card.after-cou.ig: Onye na-ekiri ihe 1 mere omume na {v0}.

n.components.practice-day-card.after-cou.ha: Masu lura {v0} sun yi atisaye a {v1}.
n.components.practice-day-card.after-cou.ig: Ndị na-ekiri ihe {v0} mere omume na {v1}.

n.app.practice-day.lede.en: On a National Practice Day every observer runs the same mock election (Party A–F) on the same day. Only the combined count is shown here, never who practised or where.
n.app.practice-day.lede.ha: A Ranar Atisaye ta Ƙasa, kowane mai lura yana yin zaɓen gwaji iri ɗaya (Party A–F) a rana ɗaya. Jimillar ƙidaya kawai ake nunawa a nan, ba wanda ya yi atisaye ko inda ya yi ba.
n.app.practice-day.lede.ig: N’Ụbọchị Omume nke Mba, onye ọ bụla na-ekiri ihe na-eme otu ntuli aka omume (Party A–F) n’otu ụbọchị. Naanị ngụkọta niile ka e gosiri ebe a, ọ bụghị onye mere omume ma ọ bụ ebe o mere ya.
n.app.practice-day.lede.yo: Ní Ọjọ́ Àdánwò Orílẹ̀-èdè, gbogbo olùwòran ló ń ṣe ìdìbò àdánwò kan náà (Party A–F) ní ọjọ́ kan náà. Àpapọ̀ ìkàyè nìkan ni a fi hàn níbí, kì í ṣe ẹni tó ṣe àdánwò tàbí ibi tó ti ṣe é.

n.app.practice-day.status-before.en: Opens {v0}, {v1}. The count appears here once it opens.
n.app.practice-day.status-before.ha: Zai buɗe {v0}, {v1}. Ƙidayar za ta bayyana a nan da zarar ya buɗe.
n.app.practice-day.status-before.ig: Ọ ga-emepe {v0}, {v1}. Ngụkọta ga-apụta ebe a ozugbo o mepere.
n.app.practice-day.status-before.yo: Yóò ṣí ní {v0}, {v1}. Ìkàyè yóò hàn níbí ní kété tí ó bá ṣí.

n.app.practice-day.status-live.en: Open now until {v0} WAT. The count updates every minute.
n.app.practice-day.status-live.ha: A buɗe yake yanzu har zuwa {v0} WAT. Ƙidayar tana sabuntawa kowane minti.
n.app.practice-day.status-live.ig: Ọ meghere ugbu a ruo {v0} WAT. Ngụkọta na-emelite kwa nkeji.
n.app.practice-day.status-live.yo: Ó ṣí sílẹ̀ báyìí títí di {v0} WAT. Ìkàyè ń ṣe àtúnṣe ní ìṣẹ́jú kọ̀ọ̀kan.

n.app.practice-day.status-after.yo: Ó ti tì. Ìkàyè ìkẹyìn fún {v0}.

n.app.practice-day.combined-note.en: Each observer’s latest mock count, added together. Fictional parties only.
n.app.practice-day.combined-note.ha: Ƙidayar gwaji ta ƙarshe ta kowane mai lura, an haɗa su wuri ɗaya. Jam’iyyun ƙage kawai.
n.app.practice-day.combined-note.ig: Ngụkọta omume ikpeazụ nke onye ọ bụla na-ekiri ihe, a gbakọtara ha. Naanị otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị e chepụtara echepụta.
n.app.practice-day.combined-note.yo: Ìkàyè àdánwò ìkẹyìn olùwòran kọ̀ọ̀kan, tí a ṣe àkópọ̀ rẹ̀. Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú àròsọ nìkan.

n.app.practice-day.method.en: Counts observers who were signed in on the phone they practised on. Hawkeye team accounts are left out.
n.app.practice-day.method.ha: Ana ƙirga masu lura da suka shiga asusunsu a wayar da suka yi atisaye da ita. Ba a ƙirga asusun ƙungiyar Hawkeye ba.
n.app.practice-day.method.ig: Ọ na-agụ ndị na-ekiri ihe banyere n’akaụntụ ha na ekwentị ha ji mee omume. A naghị agụ akaụntụ ndị otu Hawkeye.
n.app.practice-day.method.yo: Ó ń ka àwọn olùwòran tí wọ́n wọlé sí àkàǹtì wọn lórí fóònù tí wọ́n fi ṣe àdánwò. A kò ka àkàǹtì ẹgbẹ́ Hawkeye.

n.app.practice-day.none-scheduled.en: No Practice Day is scheduled right now.
n.app.practice-day.none-scheduled.ha: Babu Ranar Atisaye da aka tsara a yanzu.
n.app.practice-day.none-scheduled.ig: Enweghị Ụbọchị Omume a haziri ugbu a.
n.app.practice-day.none-scheduled.yo: Kò sí Ọjọ́ Àdánwò tí a ṣètò báyìí.

n.app.practice-day.load-error.en: Could not load the Practice Day count. Check your connection and try again.
n.app.practice-day.load-error.ha: Ba a iya loda ƙidayar Ranar Atisaye ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
n.app.practice-day.load-error.ig: Enweghị ike ibudata ngụkọta Ụbọchị Omume. Lelee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
n.app.practice-day.load-error.yo: A kò lè gbé ìkàyè Ọjọ́ Àdánwò wá. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì tún gbìyànjú.
